title: EnrollRequestV1
description: Bootstrap enrollment request. `token` is the one-time enrollment code (or the configured bootstrap secret): it authorizes the join and is consumed as enrollment state, never as a standing credential. `publicKey`/`keyAlgorithm` are the endpoint's Ed25519 identity, required whenever the enrollment is keyed (as opposed to OIDC-asserted, where identity stays the issuer trust).

publicKey.description: One raw Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding (32 bytes => 43 or 44 characters).
